body.description: Existing concrete building that recently completed a FIMP inspection, which identified conditions requiring repair. This project includes repairing isolated concrete spalls, replacing broken window glass, and repairing isolated damage to wood and steel windows. All work is to be performed in accordance with the Secretary of the Interior Standards for the Treatment of Historic Buildings. Project does not include any alterations.
A Conditional Use authorization is sought pursuant to Planning Code Sections 303 and 317 to legalize the combination of penthouses 4 and 5, which were merged by the prior owners in 2008.

The Project proposes a change in use to convert 6,621 sq. ft. of Retail Sales and Service Use to General Office use in order to provide additional office within an existing building. The space proposed for conversion is a ground floor retail space and basement located at the corner of Howard Street and Fremont Street.  

Project requests Conditional Use Authorization to establish a Non-Retail Sales & Service Use at the ground floor within the C-3-O(SD) district pursuant to Planning Code Sections 210.2 and 303.
